subject: Mobile Development
title: Progressive Web Apps as an Escape
description: A micro-lesson that makes Progressive Web Apps as an Escape usable.

hook.text: What if you could bypass app stores entirely by building a website that acts like an app?

buildup.text: PWAs install from a browser, work offline, and send push notifications — no store needed.

discovery.text: Companies like Twitter and Starbucks ship PWAs alongside their native apps.

twist.text: Apple limited PWA capabilities on iOS for years. In 2024, they briefly killed PWAs in the EU.

climax.text: PWAs challenge the app store model but depend on browser capabilities that platforms control.

punchline.text: Web apps avoid the store — if platforms allow it.

quiz.question: What are Progressive Web Apps (PWAs)?
options: Websites that work like native apps without needing an app store
